mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_orchestration_receipt (receipt_id, run_id, step_id, receipt_type, source, external_ref_hash, status, evidence_ref, verified_at, create_time) VALUES (#{receiptId}, #{runId}, #{stepId}, #{receiptType}, #{source}, #{externalRefHash}, #{status}, #{evidenceRef}, #{verifiedAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT receipt_id, run_id, step_id, receipt_type, source, external_ref_hash, status, evidence_ref, verified_at, create_time FROM fbs_orchestration_receipt WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY create_time, receipt_id
